about: Judgements of the claim compiler's reading of each claim in eval/claim-tests-foreign.json, one entry per claim and canonical test printed ("none" when nothing compiled). reading: right, wrong (a test that does not mean what the sentence says), or not_compiled; for a claim its author marked numeric, cause says why it did not compile (metric, form, period, phrasing). label_right, on a not_numeric claim that compiled, says whether the author's label was right. The judge is the grammar's author, a Claude Opus 5.5 session: every line is here to be audited. Readings judged before the grammar was changed come first; any added later are marked with the stage they were added at. Readings added on 18 November 2026, after the measure catalogue (app.core.measures) widened the grammar, are judged by the same session that wrote the catalogue and say so ('catalogue, 18 November 2026'); no earlier judgement was changed.
judge: the grammar's author (Claude Opus 5.5 session), 18 November 2026
